prompt: micronaut openapi multiple spec files UI frameworks support
answer:
Micronaut OpenAPI supports generating multiple specification files through:

- `@OpenAPIGroup`, which divides endpoints into separate groups.
- `@OpenAPIGroupInfo`, which allows separate OpenAPI definitions for groups.
- Versioning with `@Version` and/or OpenAPI groups.
- `micronaut.openapi.additional.files` for merging additional YAML or JSON files into the generated specification.

For UI support with multiple spec files:

| UI framework | Multiple spec files supported out of the box? |
|---|---:|
| Swagger UI | Yes |
| Scalar | Yes |
| ReDoc | No; provide your own template |
| OpenAPI Explorer | No; provide your own template |
| RapiDoc | No; provide your own template |

Micronaut currently supports generating views for Swagger UI, ReDoc, OpenAPI Explorer, Scalar, and RapiDoc. RapiPdf can generate a PDF from a specification.

Source: [Micronaut OpenAPI documentation](https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-openapi/latest/guide/index.html)
